data.action: 斜倚缸沿湿身半透蕾丝，水下手指自抚，星瞳半阖
data.camera: medium shot, steam haze, wet translucent fabric, sensual solo framing
data.description: 【宿舍浴室·深夜】女王蜂难得摘下了那副白手套，赤裸的指尖抚过浴缸边缘升起的水汽。褪到腿弯的黑色蕾丝贴在湿透的大腿上，她斜倚在缸沿，星瞳在氤氲里半睁半阖，一只手在水下缓缓拨开花瓣——「白手套之下……才是真正的本小姐……今晚，特别允许你……看清楚一点……」
data.lighting: 浴室壁灯暖光穿透氤氲水汽
data.promptProse: Bare-handed for once without her signature white gloves, Shokuhou Misaki reclines against the rim of a steaming bathtub, her black lace lingerie soaked to translucent sheerness and dragged to her thighs. One hand glides slowly beneath the water between her parted legs while her star-shaped pupils fall half-lidded in the fog, murmuring that what lies beneath the gloves is the real her, and tonight she permits you a closer look. Sensual solo composition, wet translucent fabric, cinematic lighting, volumetric steam, detailed bathroom background.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 蜕下手套的浴缸夜·「白手套之下……才是真正的本小姐」
